-- EP-488 v51 / G10: Descent alphabet (U5, 5.4-α)
-- Claim: Smaller two-step descendants of pair-supported degree-3 vertex a
-- are exactly 8a/9 or 9a/10.
--
-- Simplified target: given the 7 possible distance-2 ratios r·a where
-- r ∈ {9/10, 8/9, 10/9, 9/8, 16/15, 15/8, 16/9}, the ones with r < 1 are
-- exactly 9/10 and 8/9. This is pure numerical comparison.

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-- Of the 7 candidate ratios {9/10, 8/9, 10/9, 9/8, 16/15, 15/8, 16/9},
    exactly two are strictly less than 1: 9/10 and 8/9. Stated via
    cross-multiplication to stay in Nat/integer land. -/
theorem descent_alphabet_is_8_9_or_9_10
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hratio :
      (10 * b = 9 * a) ∨           -- b = 9a/10
      (9 * b = 8 * a) ∨            -- b = 8a/9
      (9 * b = 10 * a) ∨           -- b = 10a/9
      (8 * b = 9 * a) ∨            -- b = 9a/8
      (15 * b = 16 * a) ∨          -- b = 16a/15
      (8 * b = 15 * a) ∨           -- b = 15a/8
      (9 * b = 16 * a))            -- b = 16a/9
    (hlt : b < a) :
    (10 * b = 9 * a) ∨ (9 * b = 8 * a) := by
  sorry
